note: Where each state publishes its own Indian affairs office and its list of state-recognized Nations. 'office' and 'list' are pages read on 'checked'. status: 'published' = on the site; 'queued' = found, waiting on a read or a fix (see pipeline/queue.json); 'todo' = not looked at yet. Only pages actually read are recorded; nothing here is filled in from memory.
